mapper.delete:
delete from student where id in
#{id}
mapper.select: select student.id, student.name, student.no, student.gender, student.phone, student.degree, student.id_card, student.is_college, student.address, student.graduation_date, student.violation_count, student.violation_score, student.clazz_id, student.create_time, student.update_time from student where id = #{id}

select (case when degree = 1 then '初中' when degree = 2 then '高中' when degree = 3 then '大专' when degree = 4 then '本科' when degree = 5 then '硕士' when degree = 6 then '博士' else '其他学历' end) as name, count(*) as value from student group by (case when degree = 1 then '初中' when degree = 2 then '高中' when degree = 3 then '大专' when degree = 4 then '本科' when degree = 5 then '硕士' when degree = 6 then '博士' else '其他学历' end) order by value;

select ( case when student.clazz_id = 1 then 'JavaEE就业163期' when student.clazz_id = 2 then '前端就业90期' when student.clazz_id = 3 then 'JavaEE就业165期' when student.clazz_id = 4 then 'JavaEE就业166期' when student.clazz_id = 5 then '大数据就业58期' when student.clazz_id = 6 then 'JavaEE就业167期' else '其他班级' end ) as c, count(*) as num from student group by c order by num;
